0022600215.text: The Orlando Magic (2-7, 2-3 on the road, on a four-game losing streak) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-9, 0-5 at home, on a three-game skid) for the Magic's 10th game of the 2026-27 season, with Orlando fifth in the Southeast and 3.5 games back and 12th in the East. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), and Tristan da Silva is day-to-day with a calf strain and a game-time decision, while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Magic won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 121-117 home win on March 26, 2026.
